name: MMD2_MC_5/3
definition: A compression technique applying 2D MMD for spatial decomposition of each slice, followed by the MC_5/3 filter in the inter-slice direction, coded with 3D SPIHT.
summary: MMD2_MC_5/3 is a lossless volumetric compression technique for medical images that uses 2D multiplicative multiresolution decomposition for spatial decorrelation, distinguishing it from MMD1_MC_5/3.
